description: Append-only record of a single evangelism activity instance per ADR-2607061700 §1.16 (resolves Open Question 3: a dedicated ledger, not an overload of the MEMBERS.md identity roster — MEMBERS.md records WHO is an Adherent, this records evangelism ACTIVITY, a distinct concern). Covers both interpersonal evangelism by a human Adherent (face-to-face / door-to-door / street / online-dialogue) and actor-authored digital invitational publication (the ADR-2606281500 carve-out enforced by evangelism_gate.cljc). Deliberately carries no recipient-identifying or outcome field — the doctrine is 'never a target-list' (ADR-2606281500 rule 4); this ledger attests that compliant activity occurred, not who it reached or how they responded.

mode.description: interpersonal = human Adherent practice; digital = actor-authored invitational publication (ADR-2606281500 carve-out)

adherentDid.description: Populated when mode=interpersonal — the Adherent who practiced evangelism (cross-link MEMBERS.md dual-permanent record). Never the recipient.

actorDid.description: Populated when mode=digital — the publishing actor (e.g. kouhou/kataribe once wired, ADR-2607061700 Open Question 4)

evangelismGateScanCid.description: Populated when mode=digital — cross-link to the evangelism_gate.cljc scan result for the published content

optOutAffordancePresent.description: STRUCTURAL — §1.16(d): every recorded activity affirms an opt-out affordance was offered. Only true is valid.

coercionAttested.description: STRUCTURAL — §1.16(b): coercion is never valid. Only false is valid.

minorSoloSolicitationAttested.description: STRUCTURAL — §1.16(c): solo solicitation of a minor is never valid. Only false is valid.

voluntaryAttested.description: STRUCTURAL — evangelism is a recommended practice (修 shu), never an obligation under the current single-member operating constraint (ADR-2607061700 §1.16). Only true is valid.

charterRiderScanRunCid.description: Cross-link to the Charter Rider §2 catastrophe-veto scan run, when applicable
